explanationMd: Use commas to separate the three simple items in the series. Do not separate a subject from its verb or a verb from its object.

distractorRationale.b: The comma separates the verb from its object and the list lacks separators.
distractorRationale.a: A comma wrongly separates the subject and verb.
distractorRationale.c: The semicolon incorrectly separates the subject market from its predicate sells.
